# descope_user_attribute (Resource)

Manages a single user custom attribute definition in a Descope project. Applying this resource to a custom attribute that was previously defined in the Descope Console takes over the existing definition declaratively, though a default value configured for the attribute is preserved.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The immutable machine name that identifies the attribute. This value is called `Machine Name` in the Descope console. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `name` (String) The display name of the attribute. This value is called `Display Name` in the Descope console.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that this user attribute belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `type` (String) The type of the attribute. Choose one of "string", "number", "boolean", "singleselect", "multiselect", "date", "monthday". Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `select_options` (Set of String) The list of options to choose from when the attribute type is "singleselect" or "multiselect".
- `widget_authorization` (Attributes) Determines the permissions users are required to have to access this attribute in the user management widget. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--widget_authorization))

<a id="nestedatt--widget_authorization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widget_authorization`

Optional:

- `edit_permissions` (Set of String) The names of the permissions users are required to have to edit this attribute in the user management widget. An empty set means no restriction.
- `view_permissions` (Set of String) The names of the permissions users are required to have to view this attribute in the user management widget. An empty set means no restriction.
